verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a desktop and SaaS email client like Missive, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of any telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking opt-out control. Related items do not count toward this story: the action audit log, the bring-your-own AI API key, and the note on server-side email fetching are adjacent features, not an opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
